**Scratchpad:**

Key deductions:
- Bernita is T (given). Since Shalonda claims Bernita, Orson, and Sanket are all T, but Orson/Sanket contradict each other on Morgan, Shalonda is L.
- Shenna says exactly one of Shalonda(L), Mustafa, Martin is T. Since Mustafa/Martin contradict on Mandy, exactly one is T. So Shenna is T.
- Kristian says exactly two of Shenna(T), Disha, Martha are T. Disha/Martha contradict (exactly one is T), so total is 2. Kristian is T.
- Jaymie says exactly two of Kristian(T), Maya, Odell are T. Maya/Odell contradict (exactly one is T), so total is 2. Jaymie is T.
- Rashida says exactly one of Jaymie(T), Merlin, Oscar are T. Merlin/Oscar contradict (exactly one is T), so total is 2. Rashida is L.

Chain from Rashida being L:
- Tamika says exactly one of Alejandro, Odysseus, Bahar. Since Odysseus/Bahar contradict (one is T), if Alejandro is T, total is 2, making Tamika's claim false. So Alejandro is T and Tamika is L.
- Since Alejandro is T, his claim (all three or only one of Conception, Osborn, Muriel are T) must be true. Crista says exactly two of Christie(T), Osian, Mehran are T. Osian/Mehran contradict (one is T), total is 2. Crista is T. So Conception is T (Conception says Crista is T).
- Teressa says Tamika is L (true), so Teressa is T. Inga says exactly two of Teressa(T), Oona, Osvaldo are T. Oona/Osvaldo contradict (one is T), so total is 2. Inga is T.
- Since Inga is T, Gwenn is T (says Inga is T), and Jamey is L (says Gwenn lies), and Delfina is L (same truth value as Jamey).
- Andree says exactly two of Delfina(L), Miriam, Oprah are T. Miriam/Oprah contradict (one is T), total is 1. Andree is L.
- Shaunda says "0 or 2 of Andree, Mercedes, Mohamed are T." Since Andree is L and Mercedes/Mohamed have same truth value, total is 0 or 2. Shaunda's claim is true, so Shaunda is T.
- Vernell says exactly one of Shaunda(T), Mona, Melody are T. Mona/Melody contradict (one is T), total is 2. Vernell's claim is false, so Vernell is L.
- Lorine says Vernell is L (true), so Lorine is T.

**ANSWER: <yes, yes, yes>**
